# A splash (generated by make_env.py), origin at the water.
new
material new Spray --base-color 0.737 0.718 0.647 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.600 0.000 0.35
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.300 0.346 0.55
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.300 0.346 0.35
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.600 0.000 0.55
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.300 -0.346 0.35
material assign Spray
add mesh ico-sphere --name Drop5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location 0.300 -0.346 0.55
material assign Spray
add mesh cone --name Column --vertices 6 --radius1 0.5 --radius2 0.15 --depth 1.1 --location 0 0 0.55
material assign Spray
select all
shade flat
export splash.glb
